forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local quality control only: citation/provenance/schema/tested-scope defects or diversification from this role's own repeated source/query pattern; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: resolve LATEST/STATE pointer first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; read minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidentally opened stale/cross-role observability content and do not use it semantically
policy.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; findings/report readiness/checkpoint are never global completion; maintain nonempty frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt in receipt_namespace without reading shared aggregate ledger or other receipt directories
policy.control_freshness: obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config at that SHA; before substantive work repeat SHA-only ref lookup and refetch on changed control/config revision; once semantic work begins freeze selected config. Quarantine/discard any connector text beyond ref/object identity before reasoning.
